name: parental-control-functions
description: Cloud Functions (Firebase v2 API, nodejs20) for the consent-based Parental Control & Family Safety Platform. All privileged mutations (pairing, commands, sessions, notifications, retention) are executed here with server-side authorization — clients can never self-escalate.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth,pubsub
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
